comparison: Paired McNemar against A0, computed per seed. Report both seeds. b is A0 pass and this arm fail. c is A0 fail and this arm pass. p is the two-sided exact binomial test on the discordant pairs.
design_floor: Amendment 5's design floor did not hold under plain majority vote: a plurality of extras could replace the greedy call and drop a paired A0 pass. The bounded rule keeps the greedy answer unless every finished extra shares one normalized tool call. A split sample cannot replace greedy, so that failure mode is closed and the floor holds by construction against it. The only override is that unanimous extra call.

A1.name: greedy_then_unanimous_extras
A1.procedure: Stream the greedy answer with the anytime cutoff. Remaining time R = 10 - elapsed. If R > 0, one batch of 3 extra samples with max_new_tokens = floor(R * measured batched tok/s for table k 4 at this context / 4). Finished extras override the greedy answer only when every one of them shares one normalized tool call. Otherwise keep greedy. Record the greedy call hash, the finished-extra hashes, whether they agree, and whether the step overrode.
A1.vote: unanimous finished extras, or keep greedy

A4.derivation: Carried from amendment 4. The count is the d482c621 local_pass trajectories whose every local step still finishes at or below 10 s after the 141-token cap. The procedure is the one in d8a19e9: greedy stream, thinking tokens capped at the remaining time times the decode rate measured on the previous step (the P0-v2 table rate on the first step), and prior think blocks stripped from history.
A4.name: thinking_on
